item.title: Catherine O'Hara 'changed how so many of us understand comedy and humanity'
item.description: Catherine O'Hara was never afraid to go big. Known for roles in "Schitt's Creek," "Beetlejuice," and "Home Alone," she made her lines and characters memorable.

item.title: La Marque homicide investigation underway after overnight shooting, police say
item.description: Police say dispatch got a call in reference to a shooting, and once officers arrived on the scene, the suspect had fled.

item.title: District 18 voters head to the polls in pivotal runoff election after winter storm poll closures
item.description: Saturday is the last day for District18 voters to cast their ballot and decide between Former Houston City Councilwoman Amanda Edwards and former Harris County Attorney Christian Menefee.

item.title: Woman shot twice while sleeping in W Houston shooting, fiancé in custody, HPD says
item.description: Houston police said the woman was asleep in her bed when her fiancé allegedly shot her twice in the leg, sending her to the hospital.

item.title: This Week in Texas: ICE, NASA, and 2026 Primary races
item.description: This Week in Texas we discuss the political reaction here in our state to the ongoing ICE action in Minneapolis.

item.title: Arctic air brings more freezing weather to Houston this weekend
item.description: We've got another cold morning ahead with light freeze expected Sunday morning. Some areas north and northwest of Harris county may hit hard freeze criteria.

item.title: 'Sanford and Son' star Demond Wilson dies at 79 after battle with cancer, son says
item.description: The entertainment world is mourning the loss of 70's TV star Demond Wilson, who was most known for his role opposite Redd Foxx in the hit series, "Sanford and Son."

item.title: Woman charged with murder after deadly screwdriver attack in NE Houston, court documents show
item.description: A woman has been charged with murder after investigators say the weapon she used in the violent incident was a screwdriver.

item.title: Man posing as reality TV show executive charged with sex assault in two states, records say
item.description: A man, who court records say identified himself online as an "executive" for a streaming platform, is behind bars two years after he was charged with sex assault.

item.title: Christian Menefee named projected winner of District 18 runoff election: AP
item.description: The Associated Press has projected former Harris County Attorney Christian Menefee as winner of the Jan. 31 Congressional District 18 runoff election.
